These two forces — which the morning treated as static/carried — were both **dynamically reinforced** by the same data point.

This is a case where the interaction was not double-counted (the morning correctly avoided scoring rates-rising as fresh), but the **magnitude of the defensive bid** was underestimated. The morning said "relative bid, not absolute up license" (08-17 lesson) — and that was correct. XLU was flat absolute, +50bp relative.
